tbpn_example.episode_title: Pop Mart, the history & economics, Max Levchin, Jim Belosic

suggestions: Right-hand column labels bleed a few pixels past the right edge of their region rectangle (x=78): classic c3 and a3, tbpn a3. Widening the kernel regions to about x=88, or moving the right column from x=60 to x=54, would keep every label inside its band.

The column grid changes between bands: challenge, diagnosis and coherent_action use x = -22 / 19 / 60, guiding_policy uses x = -10 / 48. One shared three-column grid would make challenge -> diagnosis -> policy -> action read straight down instead of zig-zagging.

In the classic example the fluff column is drawn full height but holds only f1..f3 in its top third; shrinking it to about y [8, 58] for classic only would remove the dead space (tbpn needs the full height).
tbpn carries a few full-width dashed traversals across the Diagnosis band (f4 -> d6 masks, d6 -> c4 diagnoses); pairing each fluff node's y more closely with its target's y would flatten them.
viz_reviews.summary: Four captioned bands in Rumelt's order with fluff quarantined in a labelled side column; slot shapes make the read instant. Classic facts-only shows a completely empty Diagnosis band next to three loud slogans, and the two gold-ringed idea nodes land in that hole when derived is shown. Metrics clean for both examples in default and facts-only, console empty, stats lines match graph.json. Legibility 4 for a small right-edge label bleed and dense dashed diagonals through the tbpn Diagnosis band; neither obscures anything.

notes:
Research: Rumelt, Good Strategy / Bad Strategy (2011). Kernel = diagnosis (name the critical obstacle, replace overwhelming complexity with a simpler story), guiding policy (overall approach plus the trade-off it accepts), coherent actions (coordinated resource commitments that reinforce rather than fight each other). Hallmarks of bad strategy: fluff, failure to face the challenge, mistaking goals for strategy, bad strategic objectives.

Scout: three candidates returned (Levchin/Affirm 2025-08-29; Josh Isner/Axon 2025-10-02; Chris Power/Hadrian 2025-03-27). Chose Levchin/Affirm: it is the only one where the guiding policy's price is stated out loud on the record ('you have less margin and less opportunity for margin') and where the fluff (two mission statements, two claims of standing) sits minutes away from the real policy, which is exactly the contrast this framework exists to draw.

Design decisions:
- idea_bearing_slot is diagnosis. Ideas sit on d4 (0.80, no-asterisk products where the borrower's error is largest) and d6 (0.60, machine-readable true-cost layer for AI advisors).
- The diagnosis slot is deliberately mixed provenance in the TBPN example: d1, d2 and d3 are diagnoses Levchin actually states, d4, d5 and d6 are the obstacles underneath them. This is the framework's honest shape - founders state situational diagnoses, they do not state the binding one.
- Fact/derived ratio is fact-heavy (tbpn 19/6 nodes, 6/32 edges) on purpose. A transcript hands you slogans, numbers and actions; the diagnosis and every link between the kernel's layers have to be inferred. Six fact edges were found where a speaker states the connection with 'because', 'which means' or 'And so', which is what keeps the facts-only view connected.
- The classic example is Apple 1997 as Rumelt tells it, written as a scenario so the fact nodes can quote it. The three objectives (regain share, return to profitability, reassert innovation leadership) stand for the goals-as-strategy plans of the period rather than quoting a document; this is recorded in source.attribution.
- Layout starts as plane mode with four labelled kernel bands and the fluff quarantined in a band of its own on the left, since the layout hint's tree cannot put fluff to the side. The viz builder owns the final layout.

Validate: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Content correction after the scaffold (rode into the readme commit, recorded here as the content baseline): added fact node c5 to the tbpn challenge slot (Levchin's forecast that products bad for consumers are demoted by AI search, Max Levchin L5128-L5132), and re-grounded supported_by edge te16 from d4 to c5, raising it 0.55 -> 0.65 with a rewritten rationale. d6's grounding now points at the stated forecast rather than at a derived neighbour, which is what the 'every derived node reaches a fact' rule wants. The README already documents c5 and te16 at 0.65. Everything else in graph.json is identical to the scaffold once layout, labels and slot colour/shape are stripped (the remaining diff is JSON number formatting, 0.80 -> 0.8).

Viz: passed on iteration 1 (demonstrates 5, provenance 5, legibility 4, fidelity 5, no blocking issues). Layout is plane mode for both examples, four captioned kernel bands top to bottom with the fluff quarantined in a full-height lane on the left. Fluff was recoloured off the mustard #c9a227 to violet #8a6fc4 because the mustard sat too close to the engine's reserved idea gold #eda100. The critic's four non-blocking suggestions are recorded in viz_reviews for the wave review; the loop stopped at pass per SPEC 8.4. Engine limits the builder reported, none page-local: .nlabel's translateY(14px) is dead CSS because CSS2DObject writes an inline transform every frame, so labels sit centred r px below the node and clip the bottom of their own mesh on every page; the `masks` relation cannot be styled distinctly because the engine styles edges by provenance only, and an extension recolour would be wiped by the hover handler's unhover reset; the side panel does not re-fit the camera, so the right-hand column sits under the panel in the panel screenshots.

Reconcile: README label references updated to the viz builder's 14 shortened labels (bold entries only; node texts, quotes and confidences untouched). Automated check confirms every node's text, provenance tag, quote, source_ref, rationale and idea sentence, and every edge id and fact-edge quote, appears in the README's own example section. graph.json with layout, labels and slot colour/shape stripped is identical to the content commit fa17780, so the viz loop changed nothing but presentation.
